# Kangaroo Japan / 袋鼠君 (jp-buy.com)

> Japan proxy buying service. English side (Kangaroo Japan): Japanese trading cards — Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh, One Piece — bought from Mercari Japan, Yahoo! Auctions and Japanese shops, inspected, consolidated and shipped worldwide (primary market: United States). Chinese side (袋鼠君, also known as JP-Buy): 日本代购代拍 — 煤炉 Mercari 代购、雅虎拍卖代拍、日淘直邮中国，微信小程序「袋鼠君」同步服务.

Key facts (estimates; exact totals shown at checkout):
- Sources: Mercari Japan, Yahoo! Auctions, Amazon Japan; more marketplaces being added.
- Proxy service fee: from ~300–350 JPY per item (estimated).
- Japan domestic shipping: from ~300 JPY per item (estimated), varies by seller.
- International shipping: by actual weight/dimensions/destination; consolidation of multiple orders into one parcel is supported and recommended.
- TCG-safe packing: sleeve + toploader + rigid mailer; reinforced boxes for graded slabs.
- Optional paid photo inspection (front/back/corners) before international shipping.
- Honest customs declaration only; no under-declaring.
- U.S. imports 2026: no de minimis exemption; flat 10% import surcharge (Section 122, in force since 2026-02-24, scheduled to expire 2026-07-24 unless extended) plus carrier clearance fee (~$9–17/parcel).
- All prices on site in Japanese Yen (JPY).

## 中文侧（袋鼠君）关键事实

- 煤炉 Mercari 代购手续费：常规 200 日元/件（固定，不按商品价抽成）；🎉 2026-07-31 前活动期间全平台代购手续费全免，仅保留支付手续费
- 夜间优惠：每日 19:00 至次日 9:00，Mercari 自助下单享更低汇率加点
- 雅虎拍卖代拍：押金 1 元 = 200 日元出价额度，未中标押金可退；竞拍费用下单页实时显示
- 汇率：下单页实时展示日元原价 + 人民币价 + 换算汇率（按会员等级加点）
- 日本国内运费多数卖家包邮；国际运费到日本仓称重后按重量收，支持多件合箱
- 可加拍照验货（发货前实拍确认品相）
